headline: Peso mexicano extiende su caída frente al dólar antes de las minutas del Banxico
summary: The peso extended its decline against the dollar before the release of Banxico's policy minutes. Traders are adjusting to the possibility that the rate differential between Mexico and the US narrows further.
why: The peso is Mexico's currency and is sensitive to the interest rate gap with the US. Currency moves affect inflation, importers and carry-trade positioning.
why_moved: Traders are adjusting to a possible further narrowing of the rate differential between Mexico and the US. The upcoming central bank minutes are seen as a key signal.
